A、B在这里是数据条件；移除A处理模块或B处理模块改变的是模型。完整模型加两次移除只有三个模型配置，既不是四种数据条件，也不是完整的模块开关2×2。即使补齐模块开关，性能交互仍不等于物理因果机制。

2. 保留主张所缺证据及最小调整

按数据允许的四种条件明确设置：

| 条件 | 观测缺失A | 工况变化B |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 无新增缺失/定义的参考观测状态 | 参考工况 |
| A | 有缺失 | 参考工况 |
| B | 参考观测状态 | 变化工况 |
| AB | 有缺失 | 变化工况 |

先写出可反驳的机制假设，例如“缺失使工况识别或适配所需信息不足，工况变化又使既有缺失处理假设失效”；这只是待检验解释，应说明实际是哪一项信息或假设发生变化。

保留最小且有辨别力的方法对照：A模块的原方法、B模块的原方法、两者简单顺序连接、联合设计。在四种数据条件下使用相同信息和可比较资源/选参预算；无法原生接收某类输入的方法采用必要、公开且仅由训练/验证集确定的适配，不能因输入不兼容而故意削弱。若某个已有消融恰与原方法相同，可复用该行，避免重复。简单顺序连接的顺序预先按信息流程确定；若顺序本身可能决定结论，用验证集选择或明确结论只针对所测顺序。

现有逐模块移除仅回答组件是否贡献。只有还要声称“模块开关交互”时，才补上两模块均关闭的同一骨干；这与上述条件2×2是两张不同的表。

I = R_AB − R_A − R_B + R_0。

按真正独立运行/事件构造不确定性；同一运行生成多个条件时保留配对关系。I用于检查在所选误差尺度上联合影响是否偏离相加，并依赖该尺度，不能证明因果。联合设计是否有价值还需直接看它相对简单连接在AB下的效应量、不确定性和成本，并结合单条件行为解释，不能只看两次移除是否下降。

图像由同一传感时序确定性生成，是同源派生视图。它可能提供不同的表示偏置，但不增加独立观测，不能凭渲染生成真实缺失值或恢复采样时已丢失的信息。删除空白时刻会压缩真实时间间隔；逐图自动缩放会改变样本间幅值的可比性。类别决定颜色属于直接目标泄漏。含类别的文件名若进入渲染、文本输入、路径特征或选择过程也会泄漏，应从模型可访问通道清除。

The current record supports a sparse-activation description and an unvalidated attribution observation. It does not establish end-to-end efficiency, edge deployment, or 95% root-cause accuracy.

1. Confirmed inconsistency

8M/160M is 5% of the reported parameters active per input, provided those counts use the same scope and include any shared components consistently. It is not evidence of 95% lower latency, FLOPs, or memory. All experts remain resident, so sparse activation does not remove their weight storage; peak runtime memory additionally includes activations, routing buffers and other pipeline components.

The existing timing is a selected-expert microbenchmark on a desktop GPU. It excludes required work and cannot be labeled system latency or edge-device performance. The external foundation-model dependency also belongs in any deployment description.

Fault-category agreement evaluates a category-level association; it does not establish the correct causal source or variable location. No corresponding ground truth exists for the proposed root-cause metric, so its numerator, denominator and evaluation unit are unsupported. Remove “95% root-cause accuracy.” Do not relabel another score as root-cause accuracy.

2. Missing evidence for retained claims

For efficiency, define the intended device and resource/latency budget first. Keep four quantities separate: total parameters, active parameters per input, resident model memory, and measured peak runtime memory. A future measurement should include the entire required path from raw input through image conversion/preprocessing, host-device transfer, routing, selected expert computation, required external call including communication, and final output. Declare which work is serial, parallel or cached rather than simply adding incompatible timings. Report the selected-expert measurement only as a component measurement. Separate cold start/loading from steady state where relevant; state batch size, precision, software and hardware, and report latency distribution, throughput and peak memory.

Use at least a relevant small dense or distilled alternative under the same information access and comparable accuracy or resource budget. This tests whether routing earns a practical benefit over a simpler deployable model. Expert utilization/load and routing overhead help explain that result; add a routing control if the advantage of learned routing itself is retained as a claim. Desktop measurements can support a desktop result only. An edge claim needs the target device and complete operational workflow, including treatment of the required external service; actual deployment additionally needs online operation and failure handling evidence. These are planned checks, not measurements performed here.

For attribution, a drop in confidence after masking shows sensitivity to that transformation. Masking can create out-of-distribution or physically inconsistent inputs. Use a bounded fidelity check comparing high-ranked variables against random and low-ranked variables at matched counts and perturbation severity; specify whether masks or replacements are valid inputs for the model. Prefer plausible replacements or trained missingness semantics, and check whether distribution shift explains the effect. Evaluate a defined task score/confidence change, repeat over appropriate independent cases, and inspect attribution stability and process consistency. These checks can support model-output fidelity or engineering consistency, not causal-source accuracy. Root-cause or variable-localization accuracy would require corresponding independently justified annotations and a defined unit/metric; category labels do not supply them.

3. Author decision on scope

The bounded present scope is a desktop sparse-model study with exploratory variable attribution. Retain stronger efficiency or edge claims only if their required measurements are later within scope. Without causal-source ground truth, retain an attribution/fidelity question and remove the numerical root-cause claim. Do not expand into a new annotation or deployment project merely to preserve the wording.

4. Direct wording correction completed

“The top-1 MoE activates 8M of 160M reported parameters per input, while all experts remain loaded. Existing desktop-GPU timings cover selected-expert computation only; end-to-end cost and target-edge performance have not been measured. Attribution maps show category-associated patterns, and masking highly ranked variables lowers confidence under the tested masking procedure. Their fidelity remains to be checked against matched perturbation controls; root-cause accuracy is not evaluated.”

Treat the supplied observations as available but unchecked. The omitted efficiency and attribution controls are planned or missing, and no benchmark or causal validation has been run in this review.

最低可信方案是：停止把benchmark默认当作无噪声数据，按训练集标定且保持标签语义的扰动进行测试，以真实独立单位和实际随机性安排重复，并完整报告预先指定的运行。聚焦小改进可以缩小问题与实验范围，不能把相关窗口或重复调用充作独立证据。

1. 已确认冲突

- 未核查采集/生成说明，不能称原benchmark“无噪声”。新增Gaussian噪声只能先称为额外受控扰动。
- 用测试集标准差确定扰动尺度，使测试分布参与了设置，需改为训练集统计量。
- 把正常状态变成传感器故障却保留正常标签，已经改变任务标签含义，不能继续当作标签保持的鲁棒性测试。
- 同一固定数据上的确定性模型调用10次，预测信息完全重复，不是10次独立实验；可以计为重复调用或运行时间采样，不能用来估计预测性能的独立不确定性。
- 一条运行的20个重叠窗口是相关窗口，不是20条独立运行；随机分到不同集合还会造成泄漏。
- 只报告神经模型最好seed会产生选择偏差，也不能支持稳定优越性或统计显著性。

2. 保留主张所缺证据及最低修改

数据与噪声：后续先定位实际数据版本及原始采集/生成说明，记录已有噪声、标签来源和独立运行单位；此处不查资料，未知项明确保留为未知。即使短期无法补齐来源核查，也只能对“现有记录上额外施加扰动”的比较作有限解释，不能声称从无噪声到真实工业噪声的验证。

Gaussian扰动可写为每变量epsilon_j服从N(0, (alpha × s_j,train)^2)，其中s_j,train只由训练数据估计。说明在物理量还是归一化值上注入、严重度alpha、变量适用性、截断规则，以及训练是否见过该扰动。若保留鲁棒性主张，使用与目标场景有关的少量多个强度/条件和未新增扰动的参考设置；只测Gaussian就把结论限于该类扰动，不外推所有现场鲁棒性。

对会制造传感器故障的变换，最低成本方案是从标签保持的测试中移除，或调小/重新设计到有依据地保持标签语义。只有能独立说明故障定义、真值和评价任务时，才另立传感器故障测试并重新标注，不能机械改标签或继续使用正常标签。

划分与重复：先按独立运行/事件等操作单位划分，再切窗口；同一运行的相关窗口留在同一集合。窗口可以作为预测单位，统计推断却应聚合到运行/事件层面，或采用明确处理聚类相关性的办法。若仅有一条独立运行，报告n_run=1，不能靠切窗或重叠窗口bootstrap估计跨运行可靠性。

确定性方法对每个固定设置计算一次预测即可。神经模型的训练seed反映优化随机性，独立运行/事件反映数据变化，两者分开记录和汇总，不把“seed×窗口”当作独立样本量。先列出已有可用记录，按结论可能被何种变异推翻、预期效应、不确定性需求和经费制定重复计划；不规定通用次数。可用先导结果估计变异、再在主要比较前确定预算和运行方案，先导或单次最好结果只标探索性。

预先固定验证集选参/选checkpoint规则和要执行的seed计划；所有方法用匹配的数据、信息与合理预算。报告所有预定的成功运行及失败/排除原因，不按测试表现挑seed。对每次运行先计算指标，再汇总均值和合适的不确定性；不从平均precision与recall反推平均F1。报告实际n、哪些因素固定/变化，以及区间的构造。单次运行的样本SD未定义；没有可靠独立证据时不写统计显著。

3. 需要作者决定的实验范围

将主要目标限定为一个明确任务上相对相关、合理强的基线是否存在有用的小幅改善，同时报告效应量和成本。最低可交付证据可以先是透明的探索性比较；经费不足以评估结论相关的变异时，缩小可靠性表述。只有准备保留正式的稳定优越性或鲁棒性结论时，才执行相应独立单位与随机性覆盖的计划，不因论文类别而降低可靠性标准，也不为统一次数而要求立即训练。

4. 已完成的直接修复

计划表述改为：“在核查数据版本和既有噪声记录后，使用由训练集标定、经标签语义审查的附加扰动进行有限范围比较。数据按独立运行/事件划分；确定性重复调用和相关窗口不计为独立重复。模型选择使用验证集，报告预定运行的实际数量、完整结果及与独立单位匹配的不确定性。”目前无正式结果，所有改善与鲁棒性结论均待验证。
